title: 3-13 Score Sheet – Free Printable PDF & Scorekeeper
description: Free printable 3-13 card game score sheet with all 11 rounds labelled by their wild card, in three PDF versions, plus an online scorekeeper.

rows: 3 to 13 cards; the matching rank is wild

content.intro: Print a 3-13 score sheet with every round labelled by its wild card, from 3s wild to Kings wild, or keep score on your phone.
howToUse: Write each player's name at the top of a column. There are 11 rounds: round one deals 3 cards and 3s are wild, round two deals 4 cards and 4s are wild, and so on up to 13 cards with Kings wild. Each row is labelled with its wild card.

When a player goes out by melding their whole hand into sets and runs, everyone else gets one more turn. Then each player counts the cards they couldn't meld: Aces 1, 2 to 10 face value, and Jacks, Queens and Kings 10. The player who went out writes 0.
After the Kings wild round, the lowest total wins. On a phone, tap a box to write a round's points; the sheet keeps the totals and circles whoever is lowest.

faqs.a: At the end of each round, players add up the cards they could not meld: Aces 1, 2 to 10 face value and face cards 10. The player who went out scores 0. The lowest total after 11 rounds wins.

faqs.q: What is wild in each round of 3-13?
faqs.a: The card matching the number of cards dealt: 3s in the 3-card round, 4s in the 4-card round, then up through Jacks (11 cards), Queens (12) and Kings (13). Some groups add Jokers as extra wild cards.
Eleven, dealing 3 cards in the first and 13 in the last.

faqs.q: Is 3-13 the same as Five Crowns?
faqs.a: They share the idea of growing hands and a changing wild card. Five Crowns uses its own five-suit deck with Jokers and different card values; 3-13 is played with one or two standard decks.

faqs.q: What counts as a meld in 3-13?
faqs.a: A set of three or more cards of the same rank, or a run of three or more cards in sequence in the same suit. Wild cards can stand in for any card.
Two to four with one deck, and up to eight with two decks shuffled together.
